verdict.rationale: FireHydrant Signals claims 'multi-platform notifications', and escalation policies define how alert notifications reach responders, including directly notifying specific users and Slack channels. The evidence never names the individual channels or describes user-configurable per-channel rules, so support is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit push, SMS, phone-call and email delivery; per-user, per-channel notification rule configuration; independent or hands-on corroboration.
